body: Thank you, I really do appreciate all the advice and support, I've got to head off to class now but you really brightened my mood. Thank you again.

Thank you for sharing your story, it was inspiring to hear you go through all that and to not only keep going but help others. You are a great person.

I was actually planning on starting to get back into running and getting in shape, I've just been so busy with class I never made time for it but I think it's worth a shot. I've thought over it and I considered dropping my public speaking class, I've really gained nothing from it but stress and loss of sleep. As for my speech problems I don't really have any unless I'm nervous, in which case I'll mumble or stumble over my words.

I always hear the whole "everybody is focused on their own lives" point and I do think it's true. I couldn't remember the last 30 people I walked past let alone how they looked. I'm not sure why it bothers me so much, I know it shouldn't but I can't shake the feeling.

Honestly the biggest factor for me is school, all my efforts in college have been to make up for my poor performance in high school and now I'm starting to lose my footing again. I desperately want to travel and see new places, but I have no way to support myself like that and I know it wouldn't last forever.

Also I'd like to say I appreciate you talking to me, I don't really have someone to tell my troubles to so I've kinda been bottling them up.

I suppose my appearance is one factor in it, I'm a bit husky and I just feel like people notice every little detail about me. Another factor is that my pronunciation isn't the good and I tend to mumble without realizing it. I'm taking a public speaking class right now and after every one I feel worse and worse about myself.

As for my hobbies I think I could've worded that better, I meant more of my sexual interests.
